full_source.english: All of this is caused by the extraordinary circumstances of the particular time and place, for generally speaking it never happens this way: there is nothing at all about the sun that can feel cold, and nothing about the moon that can feel hot. key_rulings: Whole dbang gis skye ba preserves both causal relation and arising at phrase depth;13091 already includes caused by but that does not prove first skye ba has no contribution. Avoid isolated caused=skye ba.

Both actual originals already put spyir at d5; dispatch wording about their depths differing is overly broad. All three steng du are lexicalized relational expressions with full6941 support, not separate speculative steng or du glosses.
Whole der thal is explicitly supported23514 and local conclusion syntax. Retain at d3; isolated thal/fact is not the proposed claim.
yang at3–7 is topic/discourse and omitted;136–140 owns at all;182–186 adds the parallel negative clause and owns and199–202, not time/place and80–83.

First phyir links the general counterstatement and its evidence as reason; its English for precedes generally speaking, with colon before concrete grounds. Final phyir owns final for. All three med have separate exact ranges.

counterargument: The entire counterstatement and its concrete grounds jointly support the exception claim, so both languages share broad causal intent. This does not prove the first English for realizes this isolated source phyir: the explicit attachment of the concrete grounds is reorganized through the colon and the yin gyi / ma yin te framing. A d6 correspondence requires local ownership, not only shared discourse intent.
decision: Omit the first particle pairing as distributed restructuring; do not label phyir semantically absent and do not edit either language. Final phyir/for is a distinct supported premise link.
